title: Night café cut-away with two glowing men in a booth
summary: A building corner sliced open at night: brick café with bar, espresso machine, pendants with haze, sconces, bentwood chairs; two glowing men talking in a banquette booth, a barista. Solved camera.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.import: library_use({ id: 'recipe.recon.night-cafe-cutaway', as: 'cafe_meeting' })   // -> scenes/cafe_meeting.js + the modules it requires
usage.example: Merge settings.json theme + post into project.json settings. Edit the CONFIG block (CAM, room bounds X0..Z1, BOOTH). Set MANNEQUIN to a rigged mannequin glb to swap the bare glowing body. Re-pose the men in the S.tick (pose.recon.booth-sitters).

doc.when: A meeting, deal or stake-out in a café/bar seen from outside at night; any 'dollhouse' cut-away of a ground-floor room on a street corner.
doc.avoid: Daylight (the lighting is practicals + a cool night fill); close-ups (built for a 31 deg wide shot).
gotchas: Camera is the solved one: p (-7.23, 2.862, 6.156), look (-.343, 1.253, -.255), fov 31.075, no roll, no shift. A hand-tweaked camera drifted ~100 px: re-fit the scene, not the camera.
The booth was widened .4 m beyond the reference so nothing intersects (the reference's booth can't physically fit).
The men sit inside the booth group (scaled 1.15) at .9 x 1 x .9 and 17 cm lower; act({ seat: .47 }) re-seats them every tick.
settings.post has no cap here (the café glow was tuned under the default grade); for a saturated orange glow raise cap to .95-.97 and set ca 0.
With the user's Mixamo mannequin (MANNEQUIN = 'assets/models/mannequin.glb') the render matches the source pixel for pixel (PSNR 62.8 dB); the default bare human reads slimmer.
